name: DrumRingCarousel
job: Arrange photos around a rotating drum seen from inside-out so focus shifts naturally as it spins
visitor_action: drag or swipe to spin; arrows step; tap front photo to open
mobile: smaller radius, larger panels, swipe spins
motion: Inertia drag with velocity fling and spring settle; slow idle drift with quiet pause control; side panels fall out of focus by angle (blur, dim, desaturate); caption crossfades between photos (reduced-motion: static horizontal photo strip)

checks.render: pass (prior build); redesign not re-shot (shots disabled 2026-11-23)
checks.craft: pass (3, prior build); redesign pending visual review

art_direction: Planetarium: near-black dome with faint star field and projector halo, photos as glowing lightbox panels on a true-perspective cylinder, black-glass floor with reflections and warm light pools, depth-of-field falloff by angle
